This was a good purchase with three caveats: first, be careful with the size of beans you use in this, as I find it gets jammed very easily if your beans are small. Second, it is still a bit faster than I'd like it to be, even with the slower-feed disc (should've sprung for the variable rate one). Third, it does eat through the single-AAA battery relatively quickly -- I wish it either took a bigger battery or maybe one extra AAA battery. Aside from that, works exactly as expected, and definitely makes slow feeding more accessible/less of a chore.
